subject: ShellPkg/AcpiView: Avoid mutating HEST hardware bank count during parse
reasons: Two-part fix: adds CONST qualifiers to pointer variables and removes one erroneous write-through; single file, single parser
Adding CONST qualifiers to pointer-to-parsed-buffer variables is a correctness fix; each instance requires reasoning about whether the pointer targets read-only data
One-off fix in a specific ACPI parser; no repeated pattern across multiple parsers or files
